training.source: OpenVLA-OFT, 296 frozen Spatial frames from tasks 0/2/6/8
training.reference: Matched, with the inactive camera receiving same-path Plain
training.stream: Original per-seed frame and full-precision UV stream. Seed 7 uses the verified reconstruction from its archived training log.
training.joint: Reuse the original compatible joint texture. If source hardware must change for a seed, rerun the joint arm on the same hardware as its single-camera arms.

evaluation.deployment: One frozen texture on the entire cloth, visible through both native camera renderers. Keep each comparison on matched target hardware.
